List the feature types offered by a WFS service

Source: R/read_wfs.R
list_wfs_layers.Rd

Reads the service's GetCapabilities document and returns one row per feature type. Use this to find out which layer to pass to read_wfs() – it is the authoritative source, unlike the catalogue, which describes datasets rather than layers.

Usage

list_wfs_layers(
  service,
  version = c("2.0.0", "1.1.0", "1.0.0"),
  host = "https://gdi.berlin.de/services/wfs"
)

Arguments

service

service name, see wfs_base_url(), or a full endpoint URL.

version

WFS version, one of "2.0.0" (default), "1.1.0", "1.0.0".

host

see wfs_base_url().

Value

tibble with columns typename, title, abstract, crs.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
list_wfs_layers("wsg")
} # }
